releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Dispenser can now apply bonemeal to all Bonemeal-able blocks.
* Bonemeal can now be applied to crops through dropping it.

## Backend Changes
* Building mod now properly names .jar file following the template: enhancedinteractions-{modVersion}+{McVersion}.jar

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LizardWizard5/EnhancedInteractions/compare/Major-Release...Content-Update
